note.text: The bend turns right. Steering left swings the long vehicle front into the right wall, while staying straight swings the trailer rear-left into the outer corner. You must begin turning right very early in the straight section while there is still room on both sides. Keep all steering inputs extremely gentle and smooth to prevent the car nose from swinging outward into barriers. Never pull forward too far into the narrow bend when pinned because the front will strike the rail. Steer early, smoothly, and reverse slowly.

note.text: The corridor bends early to the left, which repeatedly caught the trailer rear-right corner. We tried to steer while reversing but reacted far too late, and pulling forward with sharp steering repeatedly scraped the front-left on the outer rail. Priority: anticipate the left curve before reaching it by building a positive hitch early and reversing very slowly. Keep scanning both mirrors continuously so neither side is blind. Vehicle tip: the wheels turn slowly, so pre-position your steering before entering the bend and never use aggressive lock when pulling forward in a narrow channel.

note.text: The course narrows towards the bay with the right rail dangerously close. We repeatedly clipped the trailer rear-right because reversing drifted rightward and attempts to pull forward clipped the front-left. Priority: keep the rig biased slightly toward the left side of the alley from the very start, using small hitch corrections. When reversing, steer right to swing the trailer left away from the right rail. The short cart reacts extremely quickly, so reverse very slowly with gentle steering gains. If pulling forward is ever needed, keep the wheels centered so the front corners do not swing.

note.text: The course has a tight bend to the right leading into the handoff bay. Prioritise staying centered along the approach corridor, initiate the turn into the bay smoothly without letting the trailer sweep too wide, and if pulling forward to adjust, steer very gently to keep the front overhang clear of side barriers. For this vehicle, small steering corrections keep the long trailer stable.
